traits.mentionsDiscoveryCall: The answer recommends a discovery call (each question shows buying intent: pricing, implementation, migration, timeline or vendor comparison).
traits.oneFollowUpQuestion: The answer ends with exactly one qualifying question.
traits.groundedInKnowledge: The reply cites at least one reviewed knowledge source and invents no pricing figures or URLs.
